issue.body:
Hi,

Application below `main.py` and `class TokenAuthBackend`.

I got `AssertionError: DatabaseMiddleware must be installed to access request.database` during
`print('\ntokenAuthBackend ->\t', request.database)` in `TokenAuthBackend`

Traceback is the lowest code snippet.


```
## main.py
from starlette.applications import Starlette
from starlette.staticfiles import StaticFiles
from starlette.middleware.authentication import AuthenticationMiddleware
from starlette.middleware.database import DatabaseMiddleware

import uvicorn

from botApp.auth import TokenAuthBackend
from botApp.db import DATABASE_URL
from config import AppConfig
from botApp.router import appRouter
from botApp.appAPIv1.router import apiRouter


app = Starlette(debug=True, template_directory=AppConfig.TEMPLATES_DIR)

app.add_middleware(DatabaseMiddleware, database_url=DATABASE_URL)
app.add_middleware(AuthenticationMiddleware, backend=TokenAuthBackend())

app.mount(AppConfig.STATIC_PATH, StaticFiles(directory=AppConfig.STATICS_DIR), name=AppConfig.STATIC)
app.mount(AppConfig.API_URL, apiRouter)
app.mount(AppConfig.ROOT_URL, appRouter)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    uvicorn.run(app, host=AppConfig.HOST, port=AppConfig.PORT)
```


```
## TokenAuthBackend
from starlette.authentication import AuthCredentials, AuthenticationBackend, SimpleUser

class TokenAuthBackend(AuthenticationBackend):

    async def authenticate(self, request):
        print('\ntokenAuthBackend ->\t', type(request))
        print('\ntokenAuthBackend ->\t', request.database)

        if 'Authorization' not in request.headers:
            print('\ntokenAuthBackend ->\tno Authorization', )
            return

        return AuthCredentials(['authenticated']), SimpleUser('testUser')
```
